findings.summary: Settle up sheet could not scroll or fit above the keyboard. Fixed: scrolls, action pinned below. Small phones not checked on device.
Group edit saved a misread amount (1,234.50 as 1). Fixed.
Android split field appended to or lost typed digits. Fixed; typing over a filled value was checked by a temporary native probe on an earlier tree.
Move to group had no Android keyboard avoidance. Fixed in code; keyboard-open layout not device-checked.
Settle up could record a payment twice (tap during the animation). Fixed: one send per opening.
Split and payer fields dropped a comma (2,50 became 250). Fixed.
Personal expense edit misread amounts with parseFloat. Fixed.
Receipt item prices stripped a comma. Fixed.

Accessibility and layout follow-ups: cached transfers in manual Settle up, errors as toasts possibly hidden and not announced, split note placement, tall edit footer, sheets that do not scroll as a whole, Move to group on iOS.
A settle-up with an unknown outcome (timeout, lost connection, 5xx) could be sent again. Fixed: no retry, balances refetched, alert to check first.
The check-first alert pointed at an Activity list that was not refreshed. Fixed.
Recurring template, inline edit, run-now and due-prompt amounts misread commas or dropped the dot while typing. Fixed. Budgets and card fees: see OPEN-9.
Typed 1,234.50 kept 1.23 in split, payer and receipt fields. Fixed: kept visible, flagged, blocks saving. A third decimal after a lone dot is still dropped: see OPEN-9.
Backend: settlements have no duplicate protection and cannot be undone.
Split editor crashed on a stored null split value (introduced during this change). Fixed.
Blank split fields were sent without a value and the server failed instead of refusing. Fixed in app and server; older apps need the backend deployed.
Budget and card fee amounts not checked; a third decimal after a lone dot is dropped (1.000 kept as 1.00).

Follow-ups from the last reviews: draft loses an unclear original price; hidden fields lose typed unclear text; previews show $0.00; Add expense locks a draft after a definite 400; zeros carried into Shares. See ROADMAP.
